title: 3D dice for the Dungeon Master's rolls
summary: The DM's screen now throws 3D dice for encounter rolls, loot tables, NPC barter checks and treasure pool d100s. They stay off the TV / player display.
items: Encounter rolls and loot tables throw their dice when the table uses a standard die (d4 to d20, or d100).
NPC barter checks you ask the server to roll, and the treasure pool's d100s when you resolve an item, are thrown on your screen.
The DM's rolls never reach the TV / player display, so secret checks stay secret.
Players' rolls from account character sheets now reach the DM's screen and the TV display too.
